transcripts.method: Purposive recent-video caption pilot. Automatic captions are uncorrected; host, advertisements, audience questions and reported channeling voices are not diarized.
transcripts.selection: Purposeful two-video-per-channel caption pilot; one additional Scranton author-text concordance sample. Upload metadata and captions independently accessed. No speaker identity inference from narrator voice.

rows.selection: First two valid video IDs in supplied recent-video order, excluding explicit donate/register/all-day-event titles; purposeful pilot, not random.

trimmedSimilarity.method: all-MiniLM-L6-v2; outer 10% of each caption document removed

transcripts.tokenization: WordPiece; non-overlapping240-token chunks, CLS/SEP; attention-mask mean pooling; chunk vectors L2-normalized, equal chunk mean per video, normalized; equal-video channel mean, normalized.
transcripts.topicDefinition: Regex matches per1,000 tokens matching [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, computed per video then averaged equally within channel. Contractions count as one word. Topics overlap; dictionary indicators are unvalidated.

deduplicatedTitleSimilarity.method: MiniLM excluding repeated masked title strings

matchedTitleSimilarity.textLevel: Titles of exactly the same English-caption pilot videos

matchedCaptionSimilarity.textLevel: Captions of exactly the same matched pilot videos

captionWithinBetween.note: Pair values reuse documents; not independent observations. No p-values or population inference.

robustness.result: Raw versus masked title rankings compared on 253 channel pairs.
Removed 10 repeated masked-title documents in sensitivity corpus.
Removed outer 10% of words at each end of every English caption document; compared the resulting channel rankings.
50 fixed-seed repetitions draw five titles without replacement per eligible publisher; nearest-neighbor repeat shares are descriptive stability, not probabilities.
Direct watch-page uploader IDs supersede inherited route assignments. Exact UTC dates supersede inherited dates; conflicts remain in video rows.
